rows.title: The germinal products set's own review: germinal answers in their species blocks, its unfinished-species messages, and its shorter Addresses card
rows.detail: A trader reviewing a germinal products notification needs to read back what the germinal pages asked for: a total gross weight in kilograms that may be a decimal, a number of packages, a storage temperature and the germinal identification details, including the details that are only kept in this service. The germinal set has its own copy of the review, so the live animals review keeps the rows it shows today. The germinal set never asks for additional details, a county parish holding number or a permanent address, so its review shows no row for them and asks nothing of them before submit. Where a selected species is short of what submit needs, the review names that species and links to its block, whether one species or several are selected.
acceptanceCriteria: In the germinal products set's review, each species block shows 'Total gross weight' with the weight entered followed by ' kg', so a weight entered as 12.5 reads back as '12.5 kg', and 'Number of packages' with the count entered (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

In the germinal products set's review, the first species block of the first commodity card shows a 'Temperature' row with the chosen answer, on every germinal notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

In the germinal products set's review, a germinal species block shows 'Identification details' as a list of each identifier field's own label and the value saved against it, the donor name or identifier, the collection and production dates and the identification mark included (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-042)

The live animals set's review shows the species rows 'Commodity code', 'Common name', 'Species' and 'Number of animals', and those four only (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The germinal products set's review Addresses card shows exactly one row for each consignment address role, labelled with that role's own heading and showing the address chosen for it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)

A germinal products notification with origin details, a commodity selection, consignment details, an import reason, arrival details, transport details, its consignment addresses, a contact address and at least one identifier saved for every selected species has nothing marked unfinished on its review and can be submitted (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-125; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with no package count is named with 'Enter the number of packages for <species>', the species name in lower case, and that entry links to the species' own block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-057, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

In the germinal products set's review, a selected species with a package count but no entry holding one of its four identifiers is named with 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for <species>', the species name in lower case, and that entry links to the species' own block; it is named the same way when it is the only species selected as when several are (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188)
notes: Rewrite of the existing row inc-105, keeping its requirements, dependencies and theme (germinal-products). Rewritten only to take the release name, the conflict id c-277 and the ruling references out of the title, detail and acceptance criteria, which the wording rules keep to the provenance bracket, and to state the Addresses card and the live-animals species rows positively instead of as absences.

Pass 2 combines three slices that are one page in one feature folder: the germinal read-back rows (req-842), the germinal copy's readiness test and shorter Addresses card (req-1843) and its unfinished-species messages (req-1841). Building them apart would repeat the same germinal notification set-up, the same review render and the same ladder three times.

c-277 settles the identifier bar for germinal products: every selected species, a lone one included, needs one of its four identifiers before submit, so the prototype's lone-species exemption is not copied into the germinal set. c-134 settles that each short species is named in its own right rather than through one 'Complete species details' entry.

The live-animals half of the per-species messages is the identification row's requirement (req-879), held by the overview-and-review branch. Built in the germinal set's copy of check-answers, so it stays in the germinal-products theme and conflicts with no other branch.

rows.title: 'Action required' and 'ITAHC is missing' on the live animals notification list card
rows.detail: A trader who has submitted a notification without its import and transit animal health certificate cannot tell from the list that anything is wrong. The list card now carries an error marker, an 'Action required' tag in place of the status, and the outstanding item in plain text under the reference, so the trader can see which notifications still need work without opening each one. The animals frontend's own list reads the state the animals backend recorded at submit.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals notification list, a submitted notification with no import and transit animal health certificate and no health certificate uploaded shows an error card with a red marker that assistive technology does not announce, an 'Action required' tag as its status, and 'ITAHC is missing' as plain text under its reference (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-148, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-017)

On the live animals notification list, a submitted notification with its certificate uploaded shows 'Submitted' as its status and nothing under its reference (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-148, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150)

Once the missing certificate is uploaded through an amendment and the notification is submitted again, its card on the live animals notification list shows 'Submitted' as its status and nothing under its reference (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150)
notes: Rewrite of the existing row inc-131, keeping its id, theme (animals-dashboard) and dependencies. This area covers only its req-939 half. Its other requirement, req-1079 (which status is a tag and which is plain styled text, on both lists), belongs to the notification-list area and brings the plantsfrontend repo with it: the combiner should merge that area's draft back into this row rather than splitting the card change in two.

c-149 settles what makes a submitted notification need action: a required document still missing, or no animal identifier where one is required, recorded by the animals backend as its own status. The animals frontend's own list is where it shows; the INS front door's count and drill-down wait on the INS dashboard's own requirements.
The status this card reads is recorded by the overview-and-review branch's submit row, so this row waits on it rather than adding a status of its own.

rows.title: 'Information is missing' on the live animals notification list card when animal identifiers are incomplete
rows.detail: A trader who submitted a notification with its certificate but without all the animal identifiers it needs has nothing on the list to tell them so. The card now shows that information is missing, worked out from what the notification recorded at submit. A commodity line whose species asks for identifiers is incomplete when it holds fewer identified animal records than the animals it declares, and a record counts as identified once one of its identifiers is filled, so a single-species consignment with no identifier saved counts as incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals notification list, a submitted notification with its certificate uploaded, but with a commodity line whose species asks for identifiers holding fewer identified animal records than the animals it declares, shows 'Information is missing' as plain text under its reference (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-149; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-094)

A single-species consignment submitted with its certificate and no identifier saved shows 'Information is missing' as plain text under its reference on the live animals notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-149; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188)

A record with one of its identifiers filled counts as identified, so a submitted notification whose certificate is uploaded and whose every declared animal has a record with one identifier filled shows 'Submitted' as its status and nothing under its reference (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-191)

A submitted notification that is missing both its certificate and its identifiers shows 'ITAHC is missing' under its reference, the certificate reading before the identifiers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-094)
notes: Rewrite of the existing row inc-147, keeping its id, theme (animals-dashboard) and dependency on the card row before it. Narrowed to the list card: its four review-page and confirmation-page requirements (req-905, req-906, req-908, req-931) move to the overview-and-review branch, which owns the review header, the species cards and the confirmation page, and are listed in this draft's splitOff. Building them here would have the animals-dashboard branch rewrite files the overview-and-review branch is already rewriting.

req-2111 (the cross-area pass's statement of the card's outstanding-items text, certificate first and then identifiers) belongs in this row too; the fourth criterion states that order so this row's own condition is unambiguous, and the combiner should fold req-2111 in.

c-133 removes the old block: an animal record counts as identified once one identifier is filled, so the identifier-driven items are built now. Today's frontend holds the identifier item back on that decision, which is the state this row changes.
The identifier item itself is recorded at submit by the overview-and-review branch's submit row, so this row reads it rather than recomputing it on the list.

rows.title: A Copy button on each import reference number, waiting on design
rows.detail: A trader copying the notification reference and the customs document code onto a customs declaration has to select each value by hand. A Copy button beside each value would do it for them. No accepted component offers one: the only candidate is marked experimental, is absent from the version in use and disappears without JavaScript, so this waits until design says whether the buttons are wanted and, if they are, which component to build them from. The section itself, with each value as text the trader can select, is built without this row.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row of the 'Import reference numbers' section, on the live animals and germinal products views of a submitted notification and on the high-risk plants view, has its own secondary 'Copy' button that copies that row's own value (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-038; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-096; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-180, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-176)

With JavaScript unavailable, the 'Import reference numbers' section shows the notification reference and the customs document code as text the trader can select, and no Copy button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-040, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-044, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-047, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-050)
openQuestions: Design answers design question 8 (copy buttons): whether the Copy buttons are wanted at all and, if so, which accepted component they are built from, since MoJ's Copy button is not accepted (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims p1-040 and p1-074). Who: the design team. The row is dropped if design drops the buttons.
notes: Rewrite of the existing row inc-198, keeping its id, its blocked status, its open question and its theme (waiting-on-design). Rewritten only to state the end state rather than hedge it inside the criterion ('If design keeps them...'), which the open question already carries, and to take the release name out of the detail.

c-294 settles the split: the section, its warning and its rows are built now with each value as selectable text, and the Copy buttons become this increment, blocked until design answers. The same split applies to the high-risk plants section, so this row changes plants too.

req-1986 carries a blockedBy, so this row stays blocked and apart from the rows that can build now. Its code is the client-side enhancement folders the waiting-on-design theme owns; the section it enhances is built by the overview-and-review branch, which is why the dependency on that branch is external.

splitOff.why: The header warning 'You need to complete animal identifiers and upload a health certificate' is drawn in the live-animals review's view header, and the outstanding items it reads are recorded by that theme's submit row. Both the review header and the notification record are in overview-and-review's touches, so building it in the parent would rewrite files that branch is already rewriting.
The header warning 'You need to complete animal identifiers' is the same view header and the same recorded outstanding items as req-905, both in overview-and-review's touches.

The inline 'Enter a minimum of 1 identifier' error in place of a species' Identification details content changes the review's species card and its incomplete-card marking, which are in overview-and-review's touches, beside the health-certificate error that theme already builds the same way.

The outstanding item 'complete the animal identifier information in the notification' is added to the confirmation page's outstanding items, and to the items the submit row records; the confirmation feature folder and the notification record are both in overview-and-review's touches.
